title: Trump slaps new tariffs on 14 nations; India faces additional 17%
content: Rejecting claims of surplus capacity in any sector, the Indian government emphasises its commitment to forging a strong bilateral trade agreement with the US. title: Egypt highway inferno kills 31 after fuel tanker overturns
content: A harrowing event unfolded in Giza's Al-Warraq district when a vehicle turned over and burst into flames. Tragically, over 30 individuals perished, while another 21 suffered injuries. Emergency services quickly arrived at the scene to extinguish the blaze and offer medical assistance. The incident took place on a major ring road in Greater Cairo, raising renewed concerns about the pressing issues of road safety in Egypt.

title: Delhi high court to hear today Saurav Das’s plea seeking travel nod to UK

His legal representation emphasized the urgent need for a hearing, arguing that a swift resolution could enable Das to participate in essential university events abroad. He reported being halted at immigration without any visible orders, claiming the travel ban relates to his scheduled discussions at UK institutions.

title: Indian Women's Hockey team creates history, climbs to world no. 4 after Japan rout
content: In a remarkable achievement, the Indian women's hockey team has climbed to World No. 4 in the recent FIH World Rankings. This success follows impressive wins against notable Asian rivals, including a historic 6-2 victory over China. The unbeaten streak they’ve maintained in the tournament has secured their place in the semi-finals, showcasing the tremendous growth of women's hockey in India over the past few years.

title: Lamp not lit atop deepathoon, Supreme Court to hear contempt case
content: The Tamil Nadu government has not complied with the Supreme Court's order regarding the Karthigai Deepam lamp lighting. This non-compliance may trigger contempt proceedings against the Madurai Collector, despite his apology. Various political parties and the Madurai district administration oppose the lighting of the lamp atop the deepathoon. The Collector reported efforts to follow the Supreme Court's directive, which were ultimately unsuccessful.

title: Musk says 'impressive work by Google', as CEO Pichai shares Neon's new Day record

Sundar Pichai shared updates on Neon's new Day-1 usage record as well as the increase in Antigravity token usage. The daily token usage surged by 82% following the launch of Argon just six weeks ago. Pichai expressed gratitude for the feedback received from users about the models.

title: ‘Fighting against BJP or us?’ Congress slams Samajwadi Party over its list
content: Congress MP Imran Masood expressed doubts about the intentions of Samajwadi Party during ongoing seat-sharing negotiations. The discussions, which lasted 3.5 hours, were complicated by SP's announcement of five candidates, causing tension. Masood emphasized that Congress seeks a significant number of seats for the 2027 elections while supporting Akhilesh Yadav for CM. SP leaders dismissed Masood's concerns as personal and affirmed no formal objections were raised.

title: Minnesota neighbour posts no-access sign, moors boat; court upholds $64k fees
content: A Minnesota couple sued their neighbour after he put up a sign claiming they had no harbour access and parked his boat along their waterfront, disrupting their attempts to sell two properties. An appeals court ruled that their property titles expressly granted water access, upheld findings of slander of title and nuisance, and confirmed a $64,061 attorney-fee award.

title: Supreme Court nixes Allahabad HC order for Rahul’s assets probe
content: Supreme Court has quashed an order from the Allahabad high court to investigate Rahul Gandhi's assets. The high court did not consider Gandhi's response before issuing the order, which raised procedural concerns. Senior advocate Kapil Sibal criticized the order, claiming it permitted a witch-hunt without examining the petitioner's standing. The court will allow Gandhi to present his arguments regarding the petition's validity and the petitioner's status.

title: Chemistry most popular subject after English for 12th CBSE students
content: In 2027, the CBSE has achieved an impressive milestone with 19 lakh candidates registering for Class 12. An encouraging trend reveals a marked rise in science registrations, notably in chemistry, physics, and mathematics. Notably, the disparity between chemistry and business studies has skyrocketed since 2019. This surge aligns with a national educational shift, showcasing a clear preference for science over commerce fields.

title: Bengal’s new business model to draw from Maharashtra, Gujarat & UP, says Suvendu
content: CM Suvendu Adhikari announced plans to replicate the industrial policies of Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat. The state government aims to restore confidence among industrialists to attract investments. Alongside these policies, a land bank is being created, addressing previous challenges in land acquisition. Efforts are underway to transform Bengal into a manufacturing hub by 2031, ensuring proper land utilization.
